say: Doing crunches to lose belly fat?
A muscle doesn't burn the fat sitting on top of it.
In a six-week trial, ab exercises alone didn't shrink the waist or the belly fat.
Across thirteen studies and more than eleven hundred people, training one body part didn't shrink the fat in that spot.
In another, people trained only one arm for twelve weeks.
On the scans, no difference between the two arms.
Spot reduction is a myth with excellent marketing.
In fifty-eight studies, it cut body fat, including the deep fat around your organs.
And to lose fat anywhere, eat and drink a little less than you use.
Your body burns its stored fat.
Move at least a hundred and fifty minutes a week.

hm2022: A proposed model to test the hypothesis of exercise-induced localized fat reduction (spot reduction), including a systematic review with meta-analysis. Human Movement 2022 (13 studies, 1,158 people aged 14 to 71: no spot reduction)
vispute2011: Vispute SS et al. The effect of abdominal exercise on abdominal fat. J Strength Cond Res 2011 (24 adults, 6 weeks)
wewege2022: Wewege MA et al. The effect of resistance training in healthy adults on body fat percentage, fat mass and visceral fat. Sports Medicine 2022;52:287-300 (58 studies)
nhscal: NHS. Understanding calories: you're likely to lose weight if you eat and drink fewer calories than you use, because your body uses its stored fat for energy
who2020: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour, 2020: adults 150 to 300 minutes of moderate activity a week, and muscle strengthening on 2 or more days
kostek2007: Kostek MA et al. Subcutaneous fat alterations resulting from an upper-body resistance training program. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2007 (104 people, 12 weeks; MRI showed no difference between the trained and untrained arm)
